mission: The UNC Vietnamese Language Program fosters real-world proficiency and humanistic growth, teaching not just what students can do in Vietnamese, but who they can become through it. We serve as a vital hub of connection and belonging for all whose lives touch Vietnam.

pillars.name: Task-Based & Real-World Proficiency
pillars.body: We equip learners with the communicative tools to navigate authentic situations with confidence. Language is learned by using it — engaging in meaningful tasks, collaborating on real-world projects, and communicating across diverse professional, social, and cultural settings.
pillars.practice: Task-based learning, authentic media, interactive communication, and functional fluency.

pillars.name: Humanistic Growth & Critical Empathy
pillars.body: Learning Vietnamese is a transformative journey that extends beyond vocabulary and grammar. We cultivate critical thinking, cultural humility, and intercultural agility, helping students reflect on their own worldviews while developing new ways of seeing, listening, and engaging with the world.
pillars.practice: Intercultural competence, reflective storytelling, critical engagement with history and contemporary culture, and identity exploration.

pillars.name: Community, Diaspora & Connection
pillars.body: Language is a bridge to community. We create an inclusive space that welcomes heritage learners, non-heritage students, the local diaspora, and global partners alike. Our program serves as a home for connection, honor, and mutual learning for anyone whose life touches Vietnam.
pillars.practice: Heritage language support, community-engaged projects, cultural events, and interdisciplinary collaboration.
